description: Abstract base class for JSON number representations, providing common functionality for subclasses representing specific number types.

classes.name: AbstractJsonNumber
classes.description: An abstract class that implements common functionality for JSON number types, parameterized by the specific Number type.

methods.name: AbstractJsonNumber
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the number value, ensuring it is not null.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Returns true indicating this is a JSON number.

methods.name: isInt
methods.description: Returns false; specific subclasses may override to indicate integer type.

methods.name: asInt
methods.description: Returns the integer value if applicable; throws if the number is not of type int.

methods.name: isLong
methods.description: Returns false; specific subclasses may override to indicate long type.

methods.name: asLong
methods.description: Returns the long value if applicable; throws if the number is not of type long.

methods.name: isDouble
methods.description: Returns true, indicating this number type supports double conversion.

methods.name: asDouble
methods.description: Returns the double value representation of the number.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the underlying Java Number object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the number value.
